definition: AI systems that process and combine more than one kind of input or output, such as text, images, audio and video.
details: Multimodal models align different modalities into shared representations so they can caption an image, answer questions about a chart, or generate a video from text. They underpin modern assistants that see, hear and read at once.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. Boil it down and it is this: AI systems that process and combine more than one kind of input or output, such as text, images, audio and video. Here is why it matters: Multimodal models align different modalities into shared representations so they can caption an image, answer questions about a chart, or generate a video from text. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Multimodal AI.

citation.title: Multimodal Machine Learning: A Survey and Taxonomy
